Wednesday 18 November 2026 · 24 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 rose 0.38% to 25,387 but decliners led 1,407 to 1,156
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +1.12% weighted by turnover, against -0.17% for the median stock, a gap of 1.3 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Brainbees Solutions Limited rose 12.8% on 118 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about guidance or investor update, “Brainbees Solutions Limited has submitted to the Exchange the Corrigendum to the Investor Presentation earlier submitted by the Company through letter dated November14…”.

TTK Healthcare Limited rose 18.5% on 66 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “TTK Healthcare zooms 20% as board mulls issuing preference shares via bonus”.

The exchange has formally asked 1 company to explain today's move: Dhanlaxmi Bank Limited. Those queries were filed after the close, so they confirm the move rather than explain it. NSE's own surveillance flagged the same names.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Yatra Online Limited (113x), K M C Speciality Hospitals (India) Limited (72x), Dhanlaxmi Bank Limited (70x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.
